criteria.criterion: While NTS1 is playing, selecting NTS2 prepares that channel without pausing, clearing, reloading or changing the audible NTS1 stream; selecting a live row alone never starts audio.
criteria.method: Ran the exact-candidate npm test suite, including delivered UI/controller regression checks.
criteria.evidence: 58/58 tests passed. Controller and delivered UI regression coverage confirms a live-row selection does not initiate playback or interrupt active audio. Simulated media only; audible host behavior is not claimed. See evidence/run-7eb2784539ec/npm-test.log.

criteria.criterion: Only an explicit Play action for the prepared NTS channel switches playback, stopping the prior stream before the new one starts and preserving shared ownership and stale-attempt protection.
criteria.method: Ran the exact-candidate suite and focused cross-thread remote-Pause reproduction, then explicitly invoked Play.
criteria.evidence: Suite passed shared-lock transfer, no-overlap, stale-attempt, and prepared-Play checks. Reproduction observed remote Pause clearing src and setting paused; explicit Play then restored the selected stream and reached playing. See npm-test.log and remote-pause-reproduction.log.

criteria.criterion: The UI and Media Session metadata distinguish what is actually playing from the pending selection, and Pause for the currently playing audio remains accessible.
criteria.method: Ran delivered browser-bundle and Media Session tests in the exact-candidate suite; inspected accepted Review bound to this commit.
criteria.evidence: 58/58 tests passed, including Media Session ownership and delivered UI/controller behavior. The independent accepted Review reports active metadata/Pause remain tied to playing audio while NTS2 is pending. No live host observation is inferred.

criteria.criterion: Handle repeated selections, selecting the active channel, remote Pause and buffering/error states without overlap or unintended restart; preserve country and archive selection behavior unless directly required by this bounded NTS fix.
criteria.method: Ran the exact-candidate suite and focused remote-Pause recovery reproduction.
criteria.evidence: 58/58 tests passed, including repeated/pending selection, active selection, buffering/error, country/archive, and source recovery checks. Focused reproduction: after remote Pause src was empty/state paused; after active reselect and explicit Play src was the NTS stream URL/state playing. See saved logs.

criteria.method: Confirmed the accepted Review report and run are bound to candidate a0cab0f4890f22a056a5cdd8946425c130d30a36; performed Verify against the same candidate. No ChatGPT audible-host observation was available.
